port_exposure_policy.title: Port Exposure Policy � expose the minimum necessary
port_exposure_policy.principle: Only expose host ports that humans or external tools directly access. Internal service-to-service communication uses the Docker network � those ports are NEVER published to the host.

exposed_ports.5050: pgAdmin � database admin UI (dev tooling, never in production)
exposed_ports.5433: postgres-test � test DB only, required for host-side npm test
exposed_ports.5173: frontend Vite (profile=frontend only, direct for HMR WebSocket)

internal_only.3000: backend NestJS (nginx routes to it � no direct host port)
internal_only.5432: postgres main DB (pgAdmin connects via Docker network)

rules: PORT-RULE-01: Never expose postgres main (5432) on host. Use pgAdmin at port 5050 for DB inspection.
PORT-RULE-02: Never expose redis (6379) on host. Use docker exec eam_redis redis-cli if needed.
PORT-RULE-03: Never expose backend (3000) on host. All API traffic goes through nginx:80.
PORT-RULE-04: postgres-test (5433) MUST be exposed � host test runner requires it.
PORT-RULE-05: Any new service added to docker-compose.yml must be classified as exposed or internal-only before the task is marked complete.

nginx_patterns.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy Patterns
nginx_patterns.config_location: nginx/nginx.conf � bind-mounted read-only into eam_nginx at /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
rules: NGINX-RULE-01: Use named upstreams (upstream backend { server backend:3000; }) � never hardcode IPs.
NGINX-RULE-02: Set proxy_http_version 1.1 and proxy_set_header Connection empty string for keepalive.
NGINX-RULE-03: Always set X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto headers on every location block.
NGINX-RULE-04: Set server_tokens off to hide nginx version in responses.
NGINX-RULE-05: For WebSocket proxying (Vite HMR) add Upgrade and Connection upgrade headers.
NGINX-RULE-06: Test before reloading: docker exec eam_nginx nginx -t. Reload: docker exec eam_nginx nginx -s reload.
NGINX-RULE-07: nginx config changes do NOT require image rebuild � edit nginx/nginx.conf then reload.

env_host_override_rule.title: Docker Service Hostname Override
env_host_override_rule.rule: ENV-RULE-01: Backend .env uses localhost for local dev. Inside Docker, postgres/redis are only reachable by service name. Always inject hostname overrides via docker-compose.yml environment block.
env_host_override_rule.required_pattern_in_compose: backend service must have: environment: { DATABASE_HOST: postgres, REDIS_HOST: redis }

lesson_learned.incident: backend container crashed with ECONNREFUSED � DATABASE_HOST=localhost in backend/.env was used inside the container. postgres is only reachable at hostname postgres via Docker network.
lesson_learned.fix: Added environment overrides in docker-compose.yml backend service.

validation_checklist.title: MANDATORY � Docker Compose / Dockerfile Pre-Completion Checklist
validation_checklist.description: Every time docker-compose.yml or any Dockerfile is created OR updated, ALL items below MUST pass before the task is marked complete.
items: [ ] Every service with build: has a matching Dockerfile at the referenced path
[ ] Every Dockerfile has a matching .dockerignore in the same directory
[ ] All target: stage names exist as actual stages in the Dockerfile
[ ] All env_file paths referenced in docker-compose.yml exist on disk
[ ] Every new service is classified as exposed or internal-only in port_exposure_policy
[ ] Services with localhost in .env have Docker hostname overrides in compose environment: block
[ ] docker compose config runs without error
[ ] docker compose up -d starts and all containers reach running/healthy state
[ ] docker compose logs <service> --tail 30 shows no fatal connection errors
[ ] nginx config validated with docker exec eam_nginx nginx -t after any nginx.conf change
validation_checklist.failure_mode: BLOCK � do not mark task complete until all items pass

lessons_learned.incident: docker-compose.yml created referencing backend/Dockerfile which did not exist � docker compose up failed immediately.
lessons_learned.fix: Created backend/Dockerfile (4-stage: deps->development->builder->production) and .dockerignore in the same task.

lessons_learned.incident: backend container crashed with ECONNREFUSED � DATABASE_HOST=localhost in .env used inside Docker container.
lessons_learned.fix: Added environment: DATABASE_HOST: postgres / REDIS_HOST: redis in docker-compose.yml backend service.
